author: Barbatos Labs
name: Valee Form View + ViewModel
description: A WPF UserControl backed by a Barbatos.Wpf.AquariusValee Form - schema-mode validation over a plain model class, with Valee.Form/Field/PasswordField already bound to real controls.

namespace.description: Namespace for the generated View/ViewModel/model - pass --namespace YourApp.Feature. Defaults to an obviously-fake placeholder otherwise, so a forgotten override is easy to spot rather than silently landing in the wrong namespace.
